model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates monthly data for three years, 2022, 2023, and 2024. The horizontal axis represents months, labeled I through XII, indicating January through December, and is not scaled. The vertical axis is labeled “%” and displays values ranging from 0 to 140,000, with tick labels at intervals of 20,000. Each month has two bars representing the data for 2022 and 2023, and a third bar for 2024. The bars for 2022 are colored orange, the bars for 2023 are blue, and the bars for 2024 are gray. The shortest bar, representing month I in 2022, has an approximate value of 90,000, while the tallest bar, representing month XII in 2024, has an approximate value of 128,000. The bars are grouped by month, with each year's data presented side-by-side for each month. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
